recent_articles.title: ‘Kidnapping for ransom’ triable by ATC, Peshawar High Court declares - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Peshawar High Court** ruled that a case of kidnapping for ransom, included in the Anti-Terrorism Act's Schedule, is triable by an anti-terrorism court. The court upheld an order from the ATC Hazara region that allowed for the trial of the accused under Section 365-A (kidnapping for ransom) of the Pakistan Penal Code, despite initial inclusion of the charge under Section 7 of the ATA. The court emphasized that kidnapping for ransom is a serious offense affecting public safety and societal order, justifying its inclusion in the Anti-Terrorism Act's jurisdiction.
